title: Occlusion for Free: Detecting Occlusion from the Disagreement Between Two Monocular Distance Cues
abstract: arXiv:2611.06899v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowing that a pedestrian is occluded is useful to a robot even when the detector cannot recover the hidden pixels, but occlusion estimators are normally trained on occlusion annotations that deployment settings rarely have. We show that occlusion can be read off two distance estimates a camera-only pipeline already computes. Apparent height is largely unchanged by occlusion, because the detected box still spans the whole person; monocular metric depth is pulled toward the occluder, because the nearest surface inside the box is what a depth map reports. Only their ordering matters, so no focal length, stature, or depth scale is needed, provided the depth model's error is close to a pure gain, a condition that can be checked without labels. The score detects heavy occlusion on KITTI with AUC 0.909 (0.888 over all annotated pedestrians, including those the detector misses), requires no training and no occlusion labels, and is not a proxy

translated_title: 免费的遮挡检测：从两个单目距离线索之间的不一致中检测遮挡
translated_abstract: 即使检测器无法恢复被遮挡的像素，知道行人处于遮挡状态对机器人依然有用，但遮挡估计器通常需要在部署场景中很少具备的遮挡标注上进行训练。我们证明，遮挡可以从纯相机流程已经计算出的两个距离估计中直接读取出来：表观高度基本不受遮挡影响，因为检测框仍然覆盖整个人；而单目度量深度会被拉向遮挡物，因为深度图报告的是框内最近的表面。只有两者的相对大小（排序）才是关键，因此无需焦距、身高或深度尺度，前提是深度模型的误差接近于一个纯增益，而这一条件可以在无标注的情况下进行检验。该评分在KITTI上检测严重遮挡的AUC达到0.909（在所有标注行人上为0.888，包括检测器漏检的行人），无需训练、无需遮挡标注，并且并非检测器失效的代理指标。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需训练、无需遮挡标注的方法，仅利用检测框表观高度（不受遮挡影响）与单目度量深度（被拉向遮挡物）之间的不一致性即可检测行人遮挡，在KITTI上达到AUC 0.909。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free, label-free method that detects pedestrian occlusion purely from the disagreement between apparent bounding-box height (occlusion-invariant) and monocular metric depth (pulled toward the occluder), achieving an AUC of 0.909 on KITTI.
